snippet.title: Pluto | Launch Trailer | indie.io
snippet.description:
Buy Pluto Now!

Sling spells, escape prison, and try to make it to your niece’s birthday.
Pluto is a roguelike deckbuilder where a casual wizard faces a world that takes itself very seriously.

Master a unique spellcasting system where every spell is a pattern of elemental shapes. Recipes overlap, chain, and spark unexpected strategies — every turn is a puzzle waiting to be solved.

Features:
🪄 Elemental spellcasting system with overlapping patterns
👤 8+ playable characters, each with unique mechanics
⬆️ 5+ ascension levels for escalating challenge
⏱️ One-hour runs — perfect for “just one more” sessions
💬 A design that keeps stream chat endlessly debating the optimal play

You’re not the chosen one. You’re not saving the world.
You’re just trying to be the best uncle you can.

✨ Buy Pluto on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3057670/Pluto/
